items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: The guys in there knew me and they didn’t like dislike me or anything, the guys who owned the place

ctx.x: We were talking about Charles Mingus.

Yeah. I used to go down to the Five Spot. The guys in there knew me and they didn’t like dislike me or anything, the guys who owned the place, they were very tolerant of young musicians who wanted to hang and listen. And Mingus was there with a quintet with Charles McPherson, Lonnie Hillyer, Danny Richmond, and Jaki Byard. So I had met Jaki because I lived in — I had an apartment in Boston when I was in the Navy. And I met Jaki through Tony Williams, whose mother I rented the room from. So I’d already started…
